data_move.mc:
microcode_format 2

# One shared entry; the decoder supplies the word-register destination.
instruction MOV_R16_IMM16:
    FETCH_IMM16 -> TMP0
writeback:
    TMP0 -> DST
    END

instruction MOV_RM16_R16:
    DECODE_MODRM
    READ_REG16 -> TMP0
writeback:
    TMP0 -> RM16
    END

instruction MOV_R16_RM16:
    DECODE_MODRM
    READ_RM16 -> TMP0
writeback:
    TMP0 -> REG16
    END
word_alu.mc:
microcode_format 3

# Decode supplies the functional operation, FLAGS mask and IF_WRITE permission.
# Complete instruction-byte acquisition before any immediate-form data access.
# TMP0 is always the original destination; TMP1 is always the source.
instruction ALU_RM16_R16:
    DECODE_MODRM
    READ_RM16 -> TMP0
    READ_REG16 -> TMP1
    ALU DECODED TMP0, TMP1 -> TMP2 FLAGS_DECODED
writeback:
    TMP2 -> RM16 IF_WRITE
    COMMIT_FLAGS
    END

instruction ALU_R16_RM16:
    DECODE_MODRM
    READ_REG16 -> TMP0
    READ_RM16 -> TMP1
    ALU DECODED TMP0, TMP1 -> TMP2 FLAGS_DECODED
writeback:
    TMP2 -> REG16 IF_WRITE
    COMMIT_FLAGS
    END

instruction ALU_AX_IMM16:
    READ_DST16 -> TMP0
    FETCH_IMM16 -> TMP1
    ALU DECODED TMP0, TMP1 -> TMP2 FLAGS_DECODED
writeback:
    TMP2 -> DST IF_WRITE
    COMMIT_FLAGS
    END

instruction ALU_RM16_IMM16:
    DECODE_MODRM
    FETCH_IMM16 -> TMP1
    READ_RM16 -> TMP0
    ALU DECODED TMP0, TMP1 -> TMP2 FLAGS_DECODED
writeback:
    TMP2 -> RM16 IF_WRITE
    COMMIT_FLAGS
    END

instruction ALU_RM16_IMM8S:
    DECODE_MODRM
    FETCH_IMM8S -> TMP1
    READ_RM16 -> TMP0
    ALU DECODED TMP0, TMP1 -> TMP2 FLAGS_DECODED
writeback:
    TMP2 -> RM16 IF_WRITE
    COMMIT_FLAGS
    END
word_stack_control.mc:
# Functional stack/near-control operations; no historical timing delays.
microcode_format 5

instruction PUSH_R16:
    READ_DST16 -> TMP0
    PUSH16 DECODED TMP0
    END

instruction POP_R16:
    POP16 -> TMP0
    TMP0 -> DST
    END

instruction PUSH_IMM16:
    FETCH_IMM16 -> TMP0
    PUSH16 DECODED TMP0
    END

instruction PUSH_IMM8S:
    FETCH_IMM8S -> TMP0
    PUSH16 DECODED TMP0
    END

instruction POP_RM16:
    DECODE_MODRM
    # Physical 286: a destination fault retains the completed POP's SP increment.
    POP16 -> TMP0
    TMP0 -> RM16
    END

instruction GROUP5_NEAR:
    DECODE_MODRM
    READ_RM16 -> TMP0
    TARGET_ABS16 TMP0
    PUSH16 DECODED TMP0
    REDIRECT DECODED
    END

instruction CALL_REL16:
    FETCH_IMM16 -> TMP1
    TARGET_REL16 TMP1
    READ_IP16 -> TMP0
    PUSH16 DECODED TMP0
    REDIRECT DECODED
    END

instruction JMP_REL16:
    FETCH_IMM16 -> TMP1
    TARGET_REL16 TMP1
    REDIRECT DECODED
    END

instruction BRANCH_REL8:
    FETCH_IMM8S -> TMP1
    TARGET_REL16 TMP1
    REDIRECT DECODED
    END

instruction LOOP_REL8:
    FETCH_IMM8S -> TMP1
    COUNT DECODED
    TARGET_REL16 TMP1
    REDIRECT DECODED
    END

instruction RET_NEAR:
    POP16 -> TMP0
    TARGET_ABS16 TMP0
    REDIRECT DECODED
    END

instruction RET_IMM16:
    FETCH_IMM16 -> TMP1
    POP16 -> TMP0
    TARGET_ABS16 TMP0
    ADJUST_SP16 TMP1
    REDIRECT DECODED
    END

# Shared real-mode event services; no instruction-level timing padding.

instruction POP_FLAGS:
    POP16 -> TMP0
    RESTORE_FLAGS TMP0
    END

    END

instruction SOFTWARE_EVENT:

    END

    REQUEST_EVENT DECODED
    END

instruction INTERRUPT_RETURN:
    POP16 -> TMP0
    POP16 -> TMP1
    POP16 -> TMP2

zzzzzzzzz_stack_frame.mc:
microcode_format 13

instruction PUSH_ALL:
    CHECK_PUSH8
    READ_SP -> TMP0
    SAVE_AUX TMP0
    READ_AX -> TMP0
    PUSH16 DECODED TMP0
    READ_CX -> TMP0
    PUSH16 DECODED TMP0
    READ_DX -> TMP0
    PUSH16 DECODED TMP0
    READ_BX -> TMP0
    PUSH16 DECODED TMP0
    RESTORE_AUX -> TMP0
    PUSH16 DECODED TMP0
    READ_BP -> TMP0
    PUSH16 DECODED TMP0
    READ_SI -> TMP0
    PUSH16 DECODED TMP0
    READ_DI -> TMP0
    PUSH16 DECODED TMP0
    END

instruction POP_ALL:
    CHECK_POP8
    POP16 -> TMP0
    TMP0 -> DI
    POP16 -> TMP0
    TMP0 -> SI
    POP16 -> TMP0
    TMP0 -> BP
    POP16 -> TMP0
    POP16 -> TMP0
    TMP0 -> BX
    POP16 -> TMP0
    TMP0 -> DX
    POP16 -> TMP0
    TMP0 -> CX
    POP16 -> TMP0
    TMP0 -> AX
    END

instruction ENTER_FRAME:
    FETCH_IMM16 -> TMP0
    SAVE_ALLOCATION TMP0
    FETCH_IMM8 -> TMP1
    LOAD_COUNTER TMP1
    BEGIN_STACK_CURSOR
    READ_BP -> TMP0
    PUSH16 DECODED TMP0
    READ_STACK_CURSOR -> TMP0
    SAVE_AUX TMP0
    READ_BP -> TMP0
    SET_STACK_ADDRESS TMP0
    BRANCH_ZERO finish
    DECREMENT_COUNTER
    BRANCH_ZERO push_frame
copy_parent:
    DECREMENT_STACK_ADDRESS
    READ_STACK_ADDRESS -> TMP0
    PUSH16 DECODED TMP0
    DECREMENT_COUNTER
    BRANCH_NONZERO copy_parent
push_frame:
    RESTORE_AUX -> TMP0
    PUSH16 DECODED TMP0
finish:
    RESTORE_AUX -> TMP0
    TMP0 -> BP
    ALLOCATE_STACK
    END

instruction LEAVE_FRAME:
    READ_BP -> TMP0
    CHECK_STACK TMP0
    TMP0 -> SP
    POP16 -> TMP0
    TMP0 -> BP
    END

instruction CHECK_BOUNDS:
    DECODE_MODRM
    CHECK_RM32
    READ_RM16 -> TMP0
    SAVE_AUX TMP0
    READ_REG16 -> TMP1
    SET_EA_PLUS2
    READ_RM16 -> TMP0
    CHECK_BOUNDS
    END
